name: WF-14 — Daily Social Post Generator
description: Claude generates 3 social posts daily (product spotlight, tip, promo) with image captions for FB + Instagram
post_types: Product Spotlight — feature one product with local Long Island angle
Local Tip — neighborhood tip, area event, or local news hook
Promotion — discount, deal, or limited offer for the week
steps: 2. Claude API → generate 3 posts (captions + hashtags for each)
3. OpenAI → generate matching image for each post
5. Trigger WF-17 at 10 AM to auto-post to FB + Instagram
6. Send Telegram preview to admin for approval (optional gate)
